description: The plot illustrates how ACC (%) varies with Co-occurrence Number for six methods (Base, FT, IKE, MEND, MEMIT, and ROME). The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and uses a logarithmic scale, spanning from 0 to a few thousand (with major tick labels shown at 0, 10¹, 10², and 10³). The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” on a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 85 with labeled ticks at 60, 65, 75, and 80. Six solid lines with markers are shown: Base is a black solid line with circular markers, increasing from about 62.5 at the leftmost point to about 68.8 at the rightmost point; FT is a blue solid line with downward-triangle markers, rising from about 64.2 to about 70.6; IKE is a red solid line with upward-triangle markers, rising from about 66.0 to about 72.3; MEND is a brown solid line with diamond markers, increasing from about 69.0 to about 76.8; MEMIT is a purple solid line with pentagon markers, increasing from about 68.2 to about 74.8; and ROME is a green solid line with square markers, increasing from about 73.2 to about 81.3. Across the four plotted x positions (approximately 5, 30, 300, and 3000), each line shows a monotonic upward trend with no visible decreases.
